name: Ethos Limited
summary: Ethos Limited operates a chain of luxury watch boutiques in India. The company offers luxury and premium watches; pre-owned watches; jewellery and jewellery boxes; watch straps, stands, and winders; clocks; collector boxes; and luggage products. It also provides product repair and services, including movement overhauling, battery replacement, ultrasonic cleaning, polishing, performance tests, and watch parts and strap replacement. The company sells its products through online channels. Ethos Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.
